headline: CLE @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.16 at MIL 4.38, with a projected total of 8.54. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.78 runs while MIL moved -0.93, changing the projected margin by +1.71 runs. NRFI probability dropped -5.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Parker Messick has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, William Contreras, Brice Turang, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Fry, Brayan Rocchio because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
